(define (own-last-error)
  (let ((slot 'none))
    (list (lambda () slot) (lambda (thunk) (with-exception-handler (lambda (e) (set! slot (error-object-message e)) 'caught) thunk)))))
(define pair (own-last-error))
((cadr pair) (lambda () (error "boom" 7)))
(display ((car pair)))
(newline)

(define last-seen 'none)
(define (watched thunk)
  (with-exception-handler (lambda (e) (set! last-seen (error-object-message e)) 'recovered) thunk))
(display (list (watched (lambda () (error "tile out of range" 99))) last-seen))
(newline)

(define log '())
(define (record thunk)
  (with-exception-handler (lambda (e) (set! log (cons (error-object-type e) log)) 'next) thunk))
(record (lambda () (escalate 'a)))
(record (lambda () (escalate 'b)))
(display (reverse log))
(newline)

(define (with-last-error)
  (let ((slot #f))
    (cons (lambda () slot)
          (lambda (thunk) (with-exception-handler (lambda (e) (set! slot (error-object-message e)) #f) thunk)))))
(define box (with-last-error))
(display (list 'before ((car box)) 'result ((cdr box) (lambda () (error "disk" 1))) 'after ((car box))))
(newline)
